body.statement: For every positive integer \(k\), the space of Borel probability measures on the compact metric space \(\mathcal E^k\) is compact for weak convergence.

source.locator: Chapter 2, Prokhorov compactness theorem specialized to a compact metric carrier
source.verbatim_statement: If X_n is uniformly tight, then there exists a subsequence with X_nj converging weakly to X as j tends to infinity, for some X.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the Cambridge University Press excerpt of van der Vaart, Asymptotic Statistics, Chapter 2, p. 9, Theorem 2.4(ii), retrieved 2026-09-14. Compactness of the event-time carrier makes every sequence uniformly tight.
